component: Published interop schemas and offline conformance
constraints: Six trusted local Draft 2020-12 schemas, finite CI fixtures, no remote retrieval; raw-wire and authenticated runtime checks remain separate.
No embedded deployment, throughput SLA or hard deadline is specified for this authoring tool.
alternatives: Python jsonschema with explicit deny-retrieval Registry and direct runtime comparisons.
C#/F# JsonSchema.Net with dialect and registry controls.
CUE closed constraints with independently verified standard-schema interchange.
rationale: Fresh schema, runtime, test, requirements and workflow review found no new acceptance mismatch. Preserve language-neutral JSON Schema and direct positive/negative runtime comparisons.

Alternate validators are credible consumer implementations, but do not replace raw-byte lexical checks or authentication. CUE could express richer configuration relations; that is not a demonstrated requirement here.
KEEP is based on offline validation and direct execution of actual APIs, not installed tools, familiarity or rewrite cost. No material winning migration was established.
limits: Only the Python conformance implementation was executed; this is not a cross-runtime benchmark or universal equivalence proof.
Structural acceptance never grants authority or qualifies evidence. No whole-lane completion or tactical qualification.
